objective: Implement deterministic Incident Replay that reconstructs a bounded incident window from canonical P19-B data replay, P19-C exact-match decision replay references and system-state evidence, without re-owning decision logic or introducing any execution authority.
scope: Define canonical incident marker with incident type, detected time, bounded pre/post window and trigger evidence
Consume P19-B DataReplayEngine to reconstruct point-in-time market/data context inside the incident window
Consume P19-C exact-match decision replay result/session references without re-running or mutating decision policy ownership
Bind ordered system-state / risk / firewall / data-quality incident events with exact event/availability time and source evidence SHA-256

Partition incident system evidence for every decision into known-at-decision versus retrospectively-discovered evidence using availability time, so later discoveries cannot retroactively influence the historical decision context
Produce deterministic incident replay bundle and root identity

Fail closed on incident window overflow, future system evidence, duplicate sequence/event identity, non-exact P19-C decision references, decision references outside the window or unsupported system-state taxonomy
Make input ordering irrelevant by canonical deterministic ordering
Generate deterministic P19-D same-run evidence from canonical P19-B/P19-C evidence
out_of_scope: Broker/exchange adapters, OMS, fills or orders (P20)
tests: Same incident marker/data/decision/system context produces identical incident replay root
Input order of decision/system references cannot change canonical result
Incident window must remain inside canonical replay bounds
Duplicate system sequence/event identity fails closed
Decision replay reference must be EXACT_MATCH and lie inside incident window
Data events outside incident window are excluded deterministically
System evidence with event_time before the decision but availability after the decision is classified as retrospective discovery, never known-at-decision
System evidence available by the decision time is classified as known-at-decision
P19-D evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P19-D incident replay package/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P19-A..P19-C remain canonical complete and P19-E remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
